case_title: MYERS, MEGHANN et al VS COHEN, MIRIAM

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $700.00 FILED BY MYERS, MEGHANN RIDGWAY, CHELSEA AS TO DEFENDANT COHEN, MIRIAM ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-03-2007 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COHEN, MIRIAM

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MYERS, MEGHANN RIDGWAY, CHELSEA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT COHEN, MIRIAM $20.00 PRINCIPAL, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $50.00, THE COURT FINDS PLAINTIFFS DID NOT PROVE THE EXISTENCE OF AN AGREEMENT THAT DEFENDANT WOULD HAVE AN OBLIGATION FOR MAR. THE AWARD IS BASED ON DEFENDANT'S SHARE OF UTILITIES FOR APRIL WHEN SHE WAS RESIDENT IN THE APARTMENT, THE AGREEMENT AS TO WHICH WAS EVIDENCED BY THE PARTIES CONDUCT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
